listing.name: Neutrino Detector On-Screen Display
listing.summary: Description: While Neutrino Detector is active, an OSD will show up near the hotbar listing detected entities that are not currently shown on the map. Configurable to show faction and distance, can be placed beside or above the hotbar, can be set to only show fleets while Sensor Burst is active.
listing.aiSummary: Adds an on-screen display listing detected entities not shown on the map while Neutrino Detector is active.

aiDescription: Displays detected entities near the hotbar when Neutrino Detector is active. Configurable to show faction and distance, position relative to the hotbar, and visibility only during Sensor Burst.
